tldr: 美國與伊朗宣布停火並重開荷姆茲海峽，布蘭特原油重挫、亞股開盤狂飆，台股可望挑戰45,000點。
SpaceX史上最大IPO掛牌首日大漲約19%，太空AI供應鏈題材延燒，鴻海、廣達與光通訊台廠受惠。
台積電先進封裝擴產使CoWoS缺口收斂至約一成，訂單外溢日月光、力成，蘋果iPhone 18拉長台廠旺季至2027年。
美國5月CPI升至三年高點4.2%、歐洲央行2023年來首度升息、日銀預料跟進，Fed新主席華許本周首場FOMC備受矚目。
受台股多頭與手續費收入帶動，台灣金控前5月獲利爆發，公股4金2銀大賺735億元、年增近4成。

items.title_zh: 美伊停火點燃風險偏好 台股法人喊挑戰45,000點
items.title_en: Taiwan stocks eye 45,000 as Iran truce lifts risk appetite
items.summary_zh: 美伊宣布停火、重開荷姆茲海峽後，法人看好台股加權指數有機會挑戰45,000點。油價回落舒緩輸入性通膨疑慮，歷經數周地緣政治震盪後重新點燃市場風險偏好，AI供應鏈龍頭仍是盤面主軸。不過券商提醒，後續漲勢取決於停火能否持續，以及本周全球偏鷹的利率環境；短線解讀是一波解套反彈，指數可望先站回44,000點之上，再測前高，操作上仍須留意端午連假前的變盤與成交量能否同步放大。
items.summary_en: With Washington and Tehran announcing a deal to stop fighting and reopen the Strait of Hormuz, institutional investors expect Taiwan's benchmark TAIEX to challenge the 45,000-point level. Lower oil prices ease imported-inflation worries and revive risk appetite after weeks of geopolitically driven volatility, while AI-supply-chain leaders remain the core driver. Brokers caution that follow-through hinges on whether the ceasefire holds and on this week's hawkish global-rates backdrop, but the immediate read is a relief rally that could extend the index's recovery back above the 44,000 mark.

items.title_zh: 台積電CoWoS缺口收斂至一成 訂單外溢日月光、力成
items.title_en: TSMC narrows CoWoS shortfall to ~10%, overflow lifts ASE and Powertech
items.summary_zh: 台積電持續衝刺先進封裝擴產，加速邁向供需平衡。法人估，隨台積電與夥伴全力布建新產能，今年CoWoS供需缺口可望從目前約二成大幅收斂至一成，助益全球AI出貨更順暢，2027年可望進一步達成供需平衡。由於需求仍大於供給，溢出訂單外溢至封測廠日月光、力成，受惠族群不再局限於台積電本身，先進封裝升級循環成為台灣半導體鏈跨年度題材，後段封測產能利用率與報價走勢將是觀察重點。
items.summary_en: TSMC's continued push to expand advanced packaging is accelerating its move toward supply-demand balance. Analysts estimate the CoWoS shortfall could shrink from around 20% to roughly 10% this year as TSMC and its partners ramp new capacity, smoothing global AI shipments and pointing toward fuller balance by 2027. Demand still outstrips supply, so spillover orders are flowing to backend houses ASE and Powertech, broadening the beneficiary list beyond TSMC itself and reinforcing the advanced-packaging upgrade cycle as a multi-year theme for Taiwan's semiconductor chain.

items.title_zh: 蘋果iPhone 18今秋首發、折疊機接棒 台廠旺到2027
items.title_en: Apple's iPhone 18 and foldable extend Taiwan's peak season into 2027
items.summary_zh: 供應鏈傳出，蘋果將在今年秋天先推出iPhone 18系列，首款折疊iPhone接棒明年初上市。旗艦新機連發意味台積電、鴻海、大立光等協力廠，可望打破以往旺季到年底止步的慣例，營運動能一路延續到2027年。折疊機帶來全新硬體升級循環與更高零組件價值，有利組裝、光學與機殼供應鏈，使蘋果概念台廠取得更長的訂單能見度；惟新機售價與初期良率、市場接受度仍是後續關鍵變數，須留意拉貨力道是否如預期延續。
items.summary_en: Supply-chain sources say Apple will launch the iPhone 18 series this autumn, with its first foldable iPhone following in early 2027. The back-to-back flagship cadence means key Taiwanese suppliers — TSMC, Hon Hai and Largan among them — could break the usual pattern of peak demand fading by year-end, instead staying busy straight through into 2027. A foldable launch adds a fresh hardware upgrade cycle and higher component value, supporting the assembly, optics and casing supply chains and giving Apple-linked Taiwanese names a longer runway of order visibility.

items.title_zh: SpaceX衝太空AI 鴻海、廣達、光通訊台廠迎商機
items.title_en: SpaceX space-AI roadmap opens orders for Hon Hai, Quanta and optical names
items.summary_zh: SpaceX上周五IPO募得約750億美元、收盤大漲近二成，透露市場看旺後市。隨銀彈上膛與買盤力挺，SpaceX規劃2027年前部署1GW太空算力，為鴻海、廣達及聯亞、聯鈞等雷射、光通訊台廠添新商機。光通訊被視為太空資料中心的關鍵，使AI資本支出題材從地面伺服器機櫃延伸到太空，為台灣硬體廠再添一條結構性成長敘事。法人提醒，太空算力仍處早期階段，實際拉貨與獲利貢獻時程尚待觀察，相關概念股短線易因題材消息大幅波動。
items.summary_en: SpaceX's blockbuster IPO last Friday raised about US$75bn and closed up nearly 20%, signalling strong market optimism. With fresh capital and buy-side support, SpaceX is pressing ahead with a plan to deploy 1GW of space-based AI compute by 2027, an ambition that opens new business for Taiwanese suppliers including Hon Hai, Quanta, and laser/optical-communications players such as LandMark and Browave. Optical interconnect is seen as critical to space data centres, extending the AI capex theme beyond terrestrial server racks and giving Taiwan's hardware makers another structural growth narrative.

items.title_zh: 新藥族群「八仙過海」拚海外取證 吸引資金進駐
items.title_en: Biotech's "Eight Immortals" race for overseas drug approvals draws fresh capital
items.summary_zh: 台灣生技醫藥公司挑戰國際市場蓄勢待發，今年下半年至明年初，概估至少八家公司研發的藥品技術將力拚取得海外上市許可，被稱為「新藥族群八仙過海」。業內認為，密集的取證時程有望帶動新一波資金進駐生技股，多家公司並自建銷售團隊以強化對商業化的掌控權。若能順利取得海外藥證，將是台灣生技走向國際的重要里程碑，並可能帶動族群評價重估；惟新藥審查結果具不確定性，投資人仍需留意臨床與法規風險，避免題材過度發酵後的回檔。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's biopharma sector is gearing up to challenge international markets, with industry estimates that at least eight companies will push for overseas marketing approvals for their drug technologies from the second half of this year into early next year — a wave dubbed the "Eight Immortals crossing the sea." The clustered approval timeline is expected to attract a new round of capital into the sector, and several firms are building their own sales teams to retain control over commercialisation. Success in winning overseas licences would mark a milestone in Taiwan biotech's global ambitions and could re-rate the group.

items.title_zh: 被動元件史上最長缺貨潮來臨 MLCC四巨頭同聲看旺
items.title_en: Passive-component super-cycle: longest shortage on record as MLCC giants turn bullish
items.summary_zh: 華新科表示，目前被動元件缺貨潮已是史上最長，並將延續多年，MLCC四大廠同聲看旺。AI伺服器、車用與高階消費需求大增，使積層陶瓷電容產能吃緊，高盛更點名MLCC是「下一個記憶體」，認為這輪上升循環才剛開始。供給吃緊支撐族群報價與獲利能見度，使被動元件成為AI硬體建置中除半導體龍頭外較明確的受惠者。法人指出，缺貨與漲價題材有利相關廠商營收與毛利率同步走揚，但仍須留意擴產進度與終端需求能否延續，避免循環高點後的庫存調整風險。
items.summary_en: Walton Advanced (Hua Hsin Technology) says the current passive-component shortage — already described as the longest in history — will persist for years, with the four major MLCC makers uniformly upbeat. Surging AI server, automotive and high-end consumer demand is straining capacity for multilayer ceramic capacitors, and Goldman Sachs has flagged MLCC as the "next memory," arguing the up-cycle is only just beginning. Tight supply is supporting pricing power and earnings visibility across the group, making passives one of the cleaner beneficiaries of the AI hardware build-out alongside the better-known semiconductor names.

items.title_zh: 輝達、Google率先導入 800V HVDC提前上陣
items.title_en: 800V HVDC arrives early as Nvidia and Google lead AI-power upgrade
items.summary_zh: 輝達與Google率先在AI資料中心導入800V高壓直流（HVDC）架構，使下一代電源標準提前上路。法人指出，除電源龍頭台達電外，另有至少兩家台廠可望受惠於高壓供電轉換加速。此舉因應AI伺服器機櫃飆升的功率密度——傳統電源方案已碰到效率極限；隨超大規模業者為AI運算改裝設施，電源模組、SiC元件及相關散熱、電源解決方案供應商可望取得提升的單機價值。產業界看好HVDC成為AI電源新主流，惟導入時程與規格演進仍須持續追蹤，避免標準變動造成布局落差。
items.summary_en: Nvidia and Google are first to adopt 800V high-voltage direct-current (HVDC) architecture in AI data centres, bringing the next-generation power standard forward. Beyond power leader Delta Electronics, analysts say at least two other Taiwanese makers stand to benefit as the shift to higher-voltage power delivery accelerates. The move addresses the soaring power density of AI server racks, where conventional power schemes hit efficiency limits; suppliers of power modules, SiC components and related thermal/power solutions are positioned to capture rising content value as hyperscalers retrofit facilities for AI compute.

items.title_zh: PCB大廠轉型成功 AI三大業務全面爆發
items.title_en: PCB heavyweight's three AI businesses fire on all cylinders
items.summary_zh: 一家轉型AI的台灣PCB大廠，三大AI相關業務同步爆發，法人看好翻身行情。此案例顯示AI建置效應已從晶片外溢至印刷電路板供應鏈，高層數、高速板享有溢價。隨AI伺服器、網通與高效能運算需求帶動更高階板材規格，轉型成功的PCB廠成為布局AI基礎建設的高彈性標的，獲利動能逐步反映在訂單能見度上。法人提醒，PCB族群股價對題材敏感、波動較大，投資人宜留意實際出貨與毛利率改善幅度，並追蹤客戶拉貨與產能稼動率，避免追高後遇到產業旺季落差。
items.summary_en: A major Taiwanese PCB maker that pivoted toward AI is seeing all three of its AI-related business lines explode simultaneously, prompting institutional investors to forecast a turnaround rally. The story reflects how the AI build-out is rippling beyond chips into the printed-circuit-board supply chain, where high-layer-count and high-speed boards command premium pricing. As AI servers, networking and high-performance computing demand richer board specifications, transformed PCB names are emerging as a high-beta way to play AI infrastructure, with earnings momentum increasingly visible in order books.

items.title_zh: 機電四雄 訂單旺到2029年
items.title_en: Electromechanical "big four" book orders out to 2029
items.summary_zh: 台灣四大機電設備廠訂單能見度一路看到2029年，凸顯AI資料中心與電氣化熱潮為電力與基礎建設設備鎖定多年需求。拉長的在手訂單反映資料中心、電網升級與高功率設施投資大增，需要重型機電系統支撐。如此長天期的能見度相當罕見，支撐族群較穩定的獲利預期，使機電業成為與晶片、伺服器同源AI資本支出浪潮下，相對低調的受惠者。法人認為，機電族群兼具AI與基礎建設雙題材，營運能見度高、波動相對溫和，適合作為AI供應鏈中較具防禦性的中長線布局選項。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's four leading electromechanical equipment makers report order visibility stretching all the way to 2029, underscoring how the AI data-centre and electrification boom is locking in multi-year demand for power and infrastructure equipment. The extended backlog reflects surging investment in data centres, grid upgrades and high-power facilities that require heavy-duty electromechanical systems. Such long-dated visibility is unusual and supports steadier earnings expectations for the group, positioning the sector as an under-the-radar beneficiary of the same AI capex wave driving the more closely watched chip and server names.

items.title_zh: 麥格理：AI需求超出台積電CoWoS 英特爾EMIB替補 兩台廠受惠
items.title_en: Macquarie: AI demand outstrips TSMC CoWoS, Intel EMIB steps in to benefit two Taiwan makers
items.summary_zh: 麥格理指出，AI加速器需求超出台積電CoWoS先進封裝產能，使英特爾EMIB封裝技術有機會吸納溢出訂單，並點名兩家台廠受惠。報告強化「先進封裝產能、而非單純晶圓製造，已成AI晶片產出關鍵瓶頸」的論點。隨客戶分散封裝來源以確保供給，後段生態系受惠範圍擴大，同時切入台積電與英特爾封裝藍圖的台廠可望受益。法人認為，封裝產能爭奪戰將是AI供應鏈下一階段觀察重點，相關設備與材料廠也可望同步受惠，惟須留意各封裝技術的良率與量產時程差異。
items.summary_en: Macquarie says AI accelerator demand is exceeding even TSMC's CoWoS advanced-packaging capacity, opening the door for Intel's EMIB packaging technology to absorb overflow — a shift that the brokerage says benefits two Taiwanese suppliers. The note reinforces the theme that advanced-packaging capacity, not wafer fabrication alone, is now the key bottleneck for AI chip output. As customers diversify packaging sources to secure supply, the beneficiary pool widens across the back-end ecosystem, and Taiwanese firms plugged into both TSMC's and Intel's packaging roadmaps stand to gain.

items.title_zh: 公股4金2銀前5月猛賺735億 年增近4成 華南金奪冠
items.title_en: State-run banks earn NT$73.5bn in five months, up 39% as TAIEX powers profits
items.summary_zh: 受台股行情熱絡與核心業務穩健帶動，6家公股金控銀行前5月合計大賺735.57億元，較去年同期529.37億元成長38.95%，年增近4成，其中華南金年成長逾7成最亮眼，兆豐金單月最賺續稱霸。整體上市金控前5月獲利全數出爐，13家合計狂賺3,674億元，其中5家獲利翻倍，AI熱潮帶動台股牛市，使銀行、壽險、證券子公司投資績效與業績全面爆發。法人認為，金控獲利動能與台股連動高，後續須留意股市波動對評價損益的影響，以及全年配息與淨值表現。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's six state-controlled financial holdings and banks earned a combined NT$73.557bn in January–May, up 38.95% from NT$52.937bn a year earlier, thanks to a buoyant stock market and solid core operations. Hua Nan Financial led with growth above 70%, while Mega Financial remained the single most profitable in monthly terms. Across the broader market, 13 listed financial holdings booked NT$367.4bn in five-month profit, with five doubling earnings as AI-driven equity gains lifted bank, insurance and securities subsidiaries alike.

items.title_zh: 金融業加碼台股千億級手筆 迎獲利、淨值、配息三利多
items.title_en: Financial industry adds NT$112bn of Taiwan stocks in April, eyes triple tailwind
items.summary_zh: 4月台股暴漲，金融三業（銀行、保險、證券）當月加碼台股1,121億元，推升前四月買股衝上2,953億元同期新高（金管會統計）。隨5月台股續強，金融業首季評價損失可望快速收斂，並為明年帶來獲利、淨值與配息三大利多。積極的台股配置凸顯金融業對台股多頭的高度連動，以及對投資收益日益倚重。法人提醒，投資收益占比升高雖放大多頭時期的獲利彈性，但也使金融業盈餘對股市波動更敏感，後續若台股震盪加大，評價損益與淨值波動風險亦須留意，配息政策可能因此較為保守。
items.summary_en: As the TAIEX surged in April, Taiwan's three financial sub-sectors (banks, insurers, securities) added NT$112.1bn of local equities that month, lifting first-four-month stock buying to a record NT$295.3bn for the period, according to FSC data. With the market staying strong into May, the industry's first-quarter valuation losses are expected to reverse quickly, setting up a triple tailwind of stronger earnings, recovering net worth and dividend capacity for next year. The aggressive equity allocation underscores the sector's leverage to Taiwan's bull market and its growing reliance on investment gains.

items.title_zh: 高殖利率太香 銀行、壽險4月同步砸千億搶債
items.title_en: Banks and life insurers each snap up NT$100bn+ of bonds in April amid high yields
items.summary_zh: 美債殖利率高檔盤旋，金融業再掀買債潮。金管會統計，4月金融三業合計淨買債2,492億元，寫史上同期新高，其中銀行、壽險雙雙出現千億元買盤，顯示在地緣政治與通膨疑慮升溫下，新資金續回流債市，機構鎖定具吸引力的殖利率。買債與大舉加碼台股並進，反映金融業投資組合採槓鈴策略，同時兼顧息收與資本利得。法人指出，高利環境下壽險可改善利差，但若後續利率反向走升、債券評價承壓，須留意潛在的未實現損失，及對淨值與資本適足率的影響。
items.summary_en: With U.S. Treasury yields hovering at elevated levels, Taiwan's financial industry has reignited its bond-buying spree: April net bond purchases by the three financial sub-sectors totalled NT$249.2bn, a record for the period, with both banks and life insurers each posting purchases above NT$100bn, according to FSC data. The move shows fresh capital continuing to flow back into the bond market as geopolitical and inflation concerns intensify, with institutions locking in attractive yields. The bond accumulation complements heavy equity buying, reflecting a barbell stance across financial portfolios.

items.title_zh: 比台股暴跌更可怕 金管會緊盯五家出包券商
items.title_en: FSC keeps close watch on five brokers after market turmoil
items.summary_zh: 台股劇烈震盪後，金管會表態正密切關注五家在波動期間出狀況的券商。主管機關的態度反映其對券商如何在極端盤中走勢（包括台指期夜盤一度閃崩）下管理風險、保證金與下單系統的疑慮。此一監理焦點旨在維護市場穩定與投資人保護，並可能預示當局在評估近期動盪餘波後，將加強檢視券商的風控機制、系統韌性與客戶處理流程。法人指出，若監理趨嚴，券商在系統建置與內控成本恐增加，但有助提升市場信心與長期健全度，投資人交易權益亦可獲得更完善保障。
items.summary_en: Following sharp swings in Taiwan's stock market, the Financial Supervisory Commission has signalled it is closely monitoring five securities firms that ran into operational problems during the volatility. The regulator's stance reflects concern over how brokers managed risk, margin and order systems amid extreme intraday moves, including a night-session flash plunge in the index futures. The supervisory focus aims to safeguard market stability and investor protection, and could foreshadow tighter scrutiny of brokers' risk controls, system resilience and client-handling practices as authorities assess the fallout from the recent turbulence.

items.title_zh: 15家銀行搶進 國家融保機制首期籌資13.75億美元
items.title_en: 15 banks join NT$ national financing-guarantee scheme; first tranche US$1.375bn
items.summary_zh: 為支持企業深化全球供應鏈布局，國發會「企業投資美國融資保證機制」攜手15間公、民營銀行，募資共5.75億美元，加上國發基金出資8億美元，首期專款達13.75億美元，預估可提供550億美元融資。玉山（2,500萬美元）、兆豐（5,000萬美元）、中信銀（7,500萬美元）等主要銀行均已參與。此機制旨在降低台商赴美投資的融資門檻，協助企業切入美國供應鏈。在台美關稅與供應鏈重組壓力下，融保機制被視為政策性引導資金的重要工具，後續實際動用比率與企業赴美投資進度，將是觀察成效的關鍵。
items.summary_en: To support companies deepening global supply-chain deployment, the National Development Council's "Corporate Investment in the U.S. Financing Guarantee Mechanism" has teamed up with 15 public and private banks, raising US$575m that, combined with the National Development Fund's US$800m, brings the first tranche to US$1.375bn — enough to underpin an estimated US$55bn of financing. Major lenders including E.Sun (US$25m), Mega (US$50m) and CTBC (US$75m) have signed on. The scheme aims to lower financing hurdles for Taiwanese firms investing in the U.S., channelling them into American supply chains.

items.title_zh: 台股賺到億元後 她又回頭買保險 有錢人資產配置變了
items.title_en: After making NT$100m in stocks, she circled back to insurance — HNW asset mix shifts
items.summary_zh: 一篇高資產行為觀察報導指出，富人於股市獲利了結後，正將資金回頭配置保險，帶動4大保單類型熱銷。此趨勢反映在台股大漲後，高資產客戶傾向鎖利並轉向兼具保障、保證成分與傳承功能的商品。對財富管理業者而言，此一轉變代表保險型解決方案（含儲蓄、投資型與傳承導向保單）需求重新升溫，富裕客戶在市場不確定下，由純股票部位再平衡至成長與資本保全並重的配置。財管團隊可把握客戶鎖利後的資產重配時機，結合稅務與傳承規劃，提供整合性的家庭資產配置建議。
items.summary_en: A profile of changing high-net-worth behaviour highlights how wealthy investors, after booking large equity gains, are rotating back into insurance, with four policy types selling briskly. The trend reflects a desire to lock in profits and diversify into products offering protection, guaranteed elements and estate-planning utility after a strong stock-market run. For wealth managers, the shift signals renewed demand for insurance-based solutions — including savings, investment-linked and legacy-oriented policies — as affluent clients rebalance from pure equity exposure toward a blend of growth and capital preservation amid market uncertainty.

items.title_zh: 瘋搶太空夯股 富邦人壽獲配SpaceX 5萬股 斥資2.1億元
items.title_en: Fubon Life lands 50,000 SpaceX shares for NT$210m
items.summary_zh: 史上最大IPO、馬斯克旗下SpaceX上周五正式掛牌美股，首日股價大漲19%至161.11美元，市值突破2.1兆美元，躍升美國第六大上市公司。富邦人壽獲配SpaceX普通股5萬股，斥資約新台幣2.1億元，使台灣保戶得以間接參與這檔最受追捧的IPO，也顯示本土壽險積極布局全球題材機會。對財富管理而言，此案凸顯客戶對太空、AI與前沿科技資產興趣升高，以及機構在取得稀缺初級市場配額上的角色。財管團隊可藉此引導客戶理解新興題材的高報酬與高波動特性，並透過適當分散與長期持有控管風險。
items.summary_en: Fubon Life secured 50,000 common shares of SpaceX, investing about NT$210m, as the space company made its record U.S. market debut last Friday with a near-19% first-day surge to US$161.11 and a market cap above US$2.1tn — vaulting it to America's sixth-largest listed firm. The allocation gives Taiwanese policyholders indirect exposure to one of the most sought-after IPOs and illustrates how local insurers are tapping global thematic opportunities. For wealth managers, the case underscores rising client interest in space, AI and frontier-tech assets, and the role institutions play in accessing scarce primary-market allocations.

items.title_zh: 25歲就該想好退休 專家倡「凸曲線」滾雪球放大退休金
items.title_en: Fidelity strategist: think about retirement at 25, use a "convex curve" to snowball savings
items.summary_zh: 全球高齡化與高通膨來臨，投資人面臨預期報酬降低與長壽風險雙重挑戰。富達國際基金經理暨退休理財主管張宇翔指出，25歲入職到50歲的黃金累積期應維持100%股票配置，50歲後才逐步降風險，打破傳統提早降風險的建議。「凸曲線」策略前置成長部位，在複利效果最大化後再逐步轉向穩健，目標是打造更大的退休準備金，以對抗更長的壽命與被侵蝕的購買力。對財管而言，此觀念有助與年輕客戶溝通長期股票配置的重要性，並依生命週期動態調整風險，搭配定期定額與資產再平衡落實退休規劃。
items.summary_en: As ageing and high inflation squeeze expected returns and raise longevity risk, Fidelity International fund manager and retirement-finance head Chang Yu-hsiang argues savers should start planning at 25. He recommends a 100% equity allocation through the "golden accumulation period" from career entry to age 50, only stepping down risk thereafter, breaking with the traditional advice to derisk early. The "convex curve" approach front-loads growth to maximise compounding before gradually shifting toward stability, aiming to build a larger retirement nest egg capable of withstanding longer lifespans and eroded purchasing power.

items.title_zh: 壽險搶市 強攻投資型商品
items.title_en: Life insurers push investment-linked products in market grab
items.summary_zh: 台灣壽險業為爭奪市占，加大投資型保單銷售力道，主打結合保險保障與市場連動報酬的商品。此舉因應股市走強與客戶偏好轉變，重新點燃對投資型、變額型商品的需求，讓保戶在保留保險功能下參與市場上行。對財富管理而言，此趨勢代表商品架構更廣，並須更重視適合度、費用透明與風險揭露，因投資型解決方案正成為爭取兼顧成長與保障之富裕客戶的關鍵戰場。財管團隊在推介時，應協助客戶釐清投資型商品的費用結構、保障成本與市場風險，依風險承受度與理財目標審慎配置，避免將其誤認為單純的高報酬投資工具。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's life insurers are stepping up sales of investment-linked policies as they compete for market share, leaning on products that combine insurance protection with market-linked returns. The push comes as a strong equity backdrop and shifting client preferences revive appetite for unit-linked and variable products that let policyholders participate in market upside while retaining insurance features. For wealth managers, the trend means a broader product shelf and renewed focus on suitability, fee transparency and risk disclosure, as investment-linked solutions become a key battleground for capturing affluent savers seeking both growth and protection in one wrapper.

items.title_zh: 股市洗三溫暖 大戶把錢搬到「這地方」等風起 利息差27倍
items.title_en: Big-money savers park cash at Bankee for 1.435% rate as stocks seesaw
items.summary_zh: 近期台股大洗三溫暖，高資產投資人紛紛獲利了結或降低風險，將資金轉為現金戰備部位，等待下一次進場訊號。遠東商銀Bankee社群銀行成為熱門停泊點，主打新台幣活存年利率1.435%、高利且無上限，相較一般活存利率高出許多。此案例顯示富裕客戶在市場不確定升高時，運用高利活存作為靈活、具流動性的資金停泊處。對財管而言，現金管理工具是客戶在等待進場時機時的重要選項，財管團隊可協助客戶在保留彈性與爭取息收間取得平衡，並適時提示再投入時機與整體資產配置節奏。
items.summary_en: Amid wild swings in Taiwan stocks, high-net-worth investors have been taking profits or cutting risk, shifting funds into cash war chests to await the next entry signal. Far Eastern International Bank's Bankee social-banking platform has become a popular parking spot, touting a 1.435% NT$ demand-deposit rate with no upper limit on the high-yield balance — a yield it markets as far above the rates offered on ordinary demand deposits. The case shows how affluent clients are using high-yield demand accounts as a flexible, liquid holding pen during periods of elevated market uncertainty.

items.title_zh: 大繼承時代來臨 同一筆遺產又被繼承 還要再課稅？其實有「這項」減免
items.title_en: "Great inheritance era": relief exists when the same estate is inherited twice
items.summary_zh: 隨台灣邁入高齡社會，短時間內連續發生繼承的案例愈來愈多，尤其房價高漲下，一筆房產動輒數千萬元，遺產稅負成為許多家庭關心的課題。許多人不知道，面對同一筆財產接連發生繼承，稅法其實設有減免：依遺產及贈與稅法，在一定期間內再次繼承的財產，可按級距扣抵，避免同一筆遺產被重複全額課稅。了解此規定，可為面臨連續繼承的家庭顯著降低稅負。對財管與傳承規劃而言，這提醒高資產家庭應及早盤點資產結構與繼承時序，善用法定扣除與減免，並搭配保單、信託等工具，降低突發連續繼承的稅務衝擊。
items.summary_en: As Taiwan moves deeper into an ageing society, cases of the same property being inherited in quick succession are rising, and with property prices high, a single home worth tens of millions of NT dollars can carry a heavy estate-tax burden. Many people are unaware that tax law provides relief when the same asset passes through consecutive inheritances within a short period: the estate-tax law allows a graduated deduction so that property re-inherited within a defined window is not fully taxed again. Understanding the rule can materially reduce the tax bill for families facing back-to-back successions.

items.title_zh: 買新車不到1年想改裝？車廂設備超過「這價格」未申報要補稅15%加罰
items.title_en: Modify a new car within a year? Excise tax of 15% plus penalty if over the threshold
items.summary_zh: 財政部台北國稅局表示，已課徵貨物稅的車輛，在領取新牌照登記日次日起1年內，如進行改裝車身或加裝設備，且貨物稅完稅價格在15,000元以上，必須依規定申報繳納貨物稅。此規定旨在規範新車領牌初期的改裝行為，避免漏報；未依規定申報者，可能遭補徵貨物稅並加處罰鍰。提醒民眾若計畫於購車一年內加裝高價設備，應先確認申報時點與金額門檻，依規定主動申報，以免日後遭補稅加罰，影響權益並增加額外成本。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's Taipei National Taxation Bureau reminds owners that for vehicles already subject to commodity (excise) tax, any modification of the body or addition of equipment within one year from the day after the new licence-plate registration date must be reported and taxed if the commodity-tax taxable value of the added items reaches NT$15,000 or more. The rule is designed to police modifications in the early licence period and prevent under-declaration; failure to report can trigger back taxes at the relevant rate plus penalties, so buyers planning upgrades should check the timing and value thresholds first.

items.title_zh: 通膨拉警報 美國5月CPI年增4.2% 創逾3年新高
items.title_en: U.S. May CPI hits three-year high of 4.2%
items.summary_zh: 美國5月消費者物價年增4.2%，創逾三年新高，能源成本與中東衝突推升通膨。數據符合華爾街共識，但偏高的水準使政策制定者持續承壓，並為全球央行營造偏鷹背景。隨通膨再加速，市場重新校準升息預期，並關注Fed新主席的回應；數據也強化「反通膨趨勢停滯、利率恐須維持高檔更久以抑制物價」的疑慮。對台灣而言，美國通膨與利率走向牽動匯率、資金流向與出口企業成本，後續Fed決策與油價變化將是觀察重點，投資人須留意全球資金環境緊縮對風險性資產的影響。
items.summary_en: U.S. consumer prices rose 4.2% year-on-year in May, the highest in over three years, as energy costs and the Middle East conflict fed through to inflation. The print matched the Wall Street consensus, but its elevated level keeps pressure on policymakers and frames a hawkish backdrop for global central banks. With inflation re-accelerating, markets are recalibrating rate expectations and watching for the new Fed chair's response, while the data reinforces concerns that the disinflation trend has stalled and that interest rates may need to stay higher for longer to contain price pressures.

items.title_zh: 日銀明天預料升息1碼 利率升至1995年來最高
items.title_en: Bank of Japan expected to hike, lifting rates to highest since 1995
items.summary_zh: 日本央行預料將於會議升息1碼，將使利率升抵1995年以來最高水準。此預期之舉延續日本擺脫超寬鬆政策的正常化進程，因通膨較過去數十年更具黏性。日銀升息牽動日圓、全球套利交易與資金流向，並與美國通膨偏高、歐洲央行近期升息共同構成主要央行的偏鷹一周，顯示廉價資金時代在成熟市場持續退場。對台灣與亞洲市場而言，日圓走勢與套利資金回流將影響區域匯率與股債資金配置，投資人須留意主要央行同步收緊下，全球流動性環境變化對風險性資產評價的壓力。
items.summary_en: The Bank of Japan is expected to raise its policy rate by a quarter point at its meeting, which would push interest rates to their highest level since 1995. The anticipated move marks a continuation of Japan's normalisation away from ultra-loose policy as inflation proves stickier than in past decades. A higher BOJ rate has implications for the yen, global carry trades and capital flows, and adds to a hawkish week for major central banks alongside elevated U.S. inflation and the ECB's recent hike, signalling that the era of cheap money is continuing to unwind across developed markets.

items.title_zh: 本週操盤焦點：Fed華許首場FOMC 市場緊盯鷹鴿
items.title_en: All eyes on Fed chair Warsh's first FOMC amid hawkish fears
items.summary_zh: 近期轉弱的美股，本周將面臨一項關鍵變數——由新任主席華許領軍的Fed首場政策會議。投資人擔心為抑制通膨而進一步升息，恐打擊股市熱情，使Fed政策方向成為焦點。會議適逢「四巫日」選擇權與期貨結算，又處於美國通膨創三年新高、歐洲央行近期升息、日銀預料升息的背景下，使華許的談話與前瞻指引，對全球風險情緒及下半年股市走向至為關鍵。對台股而言，Fed決策牽動外資動向與科技股評價，端午連假前後須留意國際利率訊號與資金流向變化，操作上宜控管部位、留意變盤風險。
items.summary_en: The recently weakened U.S. equity market faces a key variable this week: the Federal Reserve's first policy meeting under new chair Kevin Warsh. With investors worried that further rate hikes to tame inflation could sap the stock market's enthusiasm, the Fed's policy direction has become a focal point. The meeting coincides with a "quadruple witching" options-and-futures expiry and lands against a backdrop of three-year-high U.S. inflation, the ECB's recent hike and an expected BOJ move — making Warsh's tone and guidance pivotal for global risk sentiment and the trajectory of equities into the second half.

items.title_zh: 勞保潛藏負債攀逾14兆 政府撥補仍難阻債務滾雪球
items.title_en: Labor-insurance hidden liabilities top NT$14tn despite government top-ups
items.summary_zh: 儘管勞保基金操作績效優異、政府大力撥補，勞保潛藏負債依舊滾雪球。據2025年中央政府總決算，勞保截至去年底精算未來50年潛藏負債持續攀升至14.2兆元，較前一年決算增加5,752億元，三年內暴增2.7兆元。擴大的缺口凸顯人口老化下，台灣勞工年金制度面臨的結構性財務缺口，升高改革壓力與持續財政挹注的需求，以維持基金長期清償能力。此議題攸關廣大勞工退休保障，後續年金改革方向、費率與給付調整，以及政府撥補的可持續性，將是各界關注焦點，民眾也宜及早強化個人退休準備。
items.summary_en: Despite strong investment performance by Taiwan's Labor Insurance Fund and sizeable government injections, the system's hidden liabilities keep snowballing. According to the 2025 central government final accounts, the 50-year actuarial hidden liability as of end-2025 climbed to NT$14.2tn, up NT$575.2bn from the prior year's accounts and ballooning by NT$2.7tn over three years. The widening shortfall underscores the structural funding gap facing Taiwan's labor pension system as the population ages, raising pressure for reform and continued fiscal support to keep the fund solvent over the long run.

items.title_zh: 美伊達成停戰協議 荷莫茲海峽周五重開 國際油價應聲大跌
items.title_en: U.S.-Iran ceasefire sends oil tumbling, Hormuz to reopen Friday
items.summary_zh: 川普宣布美伊達成停止衝突協議，並稱荷姆茲海峽周五重開，國際油價應聲下跌，布蘭特原油跌逾3%。依臨時協議，雙方同意重開海峽並展開為期60天的核計畫談判。市場關注制裁鬆綁、核協議進展與以色列態度，分析師提醒，鑑於資金與伊朗核活動等問題仍未解決，這項停火能否轉化為長期和平仍充滿變數。對全球而言，油價回落有助舒緩通膨與能源供應疑慮，提振風險性資產；惟中東局勢反覆，後續若協議生變、衝突再起，油價與市場恐再度劇烈波動，投資人須密切追蹤協議落實進度與地緣風險變化。
items.summary_en: President Trump announced a U.S.-Iran agreement to stop fighting, saying the Strait of Hormuz will reopen Friday; international oil prices fell sharply in response, with Brent crude dropping more than 3%. Under the interim deal, the two sides agreed to reopen the strait and begin a 60-day negotiation over Iran's nuclear programme. Markets are watching for sanctions relief, progress on a nuclear accord, and Israel's posture, with analysts cautioning that translating the truce into lasting peace remains uncertain given unresolved issues over funding and Iran's nuclear activities.

items.title_zh: 亞股開盤狂飆 韓股噴漲5% 日經大漲2,800點 慶美伊達協議
items.title_en: Asian stocks soar at the open on Iran deal; Korea jumps 5%, Nikkei up 2,800
items.summary_zh: 亞洲股市周一開盤狂飆，慶祝美伊達成協議，韓股噴漲約5%，日經指數大漲約2,800點。強勁反彈反映廣泛的解套交易，中東情勢降溫、荷姆茲海峽恢復通航與油價回落，全面提振區域風險偏好。此走勢為包括台灣在內的亞洲市場定下偏多基調，但投資人仍留意漲勢能否持續，取決於停火是否穩固及本周各國央行決策。對台股而言，亞股同步走強有利氣氛，惟須留意獲利了結賣壓與全球偏鷹利率環境，連假前波動可能加大，宜留意量能與外資動向能否同步配合。
items.summary_en: Asian equity markets surged at Monday's open to celebrate the U.S.-Iran agreement, with South Korean stocks spiking about 5% and Japan's Nikkei jumping some 2,800 points. The sharp rally reflects a broad relief trade as the prospect of de-escalation in the Middle East, reopened shipping through the Strait of Hormuz and lower oil prices lifted risk appetite across the region. The moves set a bullish tone for Asian markets, including Taiwan, though investors remain mindful that the durability of the gains hinges on the ceasefire holding and on this week's central-bank decisions.

items.title_zh: 美銀點名美伊和平「6大」受惠資產 消費股、比特幣、黃金全上榜
items.title_en: BofA names six "peace beneficiary" assets as Iran-deal bets build
items.summary_zh: 隨市場押注美伊和平協議即將達成，美國銀行首席策略師Michael Hartnett發布「和平受益者」名單，看好消費股、REITs、歐洲股票、比特幣、黃金，以及印度盧比、印尼盾等新興市場貨幣。此觀點勾勒出中東降溫可能使資金輪動至風險性與利率敏感資產。值得注意的是，美銀自家牛熊指標仍維持賣出訊號，顯示即便和平題材增溫仍須謹慎——提醒整體部位與估值風險並未消失。對投資人而言，和平受惠題材雖具吸引力，但在全球央行偏鷹、估值偏高背景下，宜分散布局並控管風險，避免單押單一題材。
items.summary_en: As markets wager on an imminent U.S.-Iran peace deal, Bank of America chief strategist Michael Hartnett published a "peace beneficiaries" list, favouring consumer stocks, REITs, European equities, bitcoin, gold and emerging-market currencies such as the Indian rupee and Indonesian rupiah. The call frames how a Middle East de-escalation could rotate capital toward risk and rate-sensitive assets. Notably, however, BofA's proprietary bull-bear indicator still flashes a sell signal, suggesting caution even as the peace theme gains traction — a reminder that broader positioning and valuation risks have not disappeared.

items.title_zh: 中國怒批美國將阿里、百度等列軍事企業名單 將「強力反制」
items.title_en: China vows "forceful countermeasures" after U.S. lists Alibaba, Baidu as military firms
items.summary_zh: 美國國防部將阿里巴巴、百度、蔚來、比亞迪及多家中國企業納入「中國軍事企業」名單，引發中國商務部強烈不滿。北京批評美方濫用國家安全概念打壓中企，並警告將採取堅決反制。此舉為中美貿易休兵後的雙邊關係再添摩擦，升高再度針鋒相對的風險。對全球投資人而言，此一升溫凸顯即便市場期待情勢穩定，與美中科技、貿易緊張相關的地緣政治與供應鏈風險仍揮之不去。台廠位處美中科技角力前沿，須留意後續管制與反制措施對供應鏈布局、客戶結構與出口的潛在影響，分散市場與風險管理愈顯重要。
items.summary_en: China's Commerce Ministry voiced strong displeasure after the U.S. Defense Department added Alibaba, Baidu, NIO, BYD and other Chinese companies to its "Chinese military companies" list. Beijing accused Washington of abusing the concept of national security to suppress Chinese firms and warned it would take resolute countermeasures. The move adds fresh friction to U.S.-China relations following a trade truce, raising the risk of renewed tit-for-tat measures. For global investors, the escalation underscores lingering geopolitical and supply-chain risks tied to U.S.-China tech and trade tensions even amid hopes for stabilisation.
